title: Waivers of the ban on asking for donations, and the gifts reported afterwards
question: For each waiver the Board approved, which departments does it cover, and what gifts did those departments itemise after the approval date?
finding: The export lists 29 waivers approved 2023-02-09 to 2026-10-02 (5 in 2023, 4 in 2024, 16 in 2025, 4 in 2026); 0 are new since the 12 November download. 2 name "City contractors" as the payors. The departments they cover itemised gifts after the approval dates for 28 of the waivers; the gift reports name the donor, the waiver list does not.
how: Each waiver's "agency" text is matched to the departments that file gift reports (by department name; "Mayor" to the Mayor's Office). Gifts in the itemised list (12 November download, November 2024 to October 2026) received by those departments on or after the approval date are counted, and the three largest organization donors named.
limits: A waiver is an approval by the Board, and a gift reported by a department is not necessarily one solicited under a waiver: the gift reports do not say which waiver, if any, a gift came under. Payments made directly to a nonprofit at an official's request are not department gifts and do not appear in this list. Individual donors are not named.
